front: How do you build a leak-free 7-day mean feature?
back: s.shift(1).rolling(7).mean(). The shift keeps today's value out of the window.

front: rolling vs resample: how many rows do you get?
back: rolling keeps one row per original row. resample makes one row per new period, so the series is shorter.

front: Which aggregation for hourly kWh to daily kWh?
back: sum. Totals are summed. Levels such as temperature use mean.
